purpose: Crotamiton is used to treat scabies, which is a skin infestation caused by tiny mites that burrow into your skin and cause intense itching. It can also be used to relieve itching from other skin conditions. It helps get rid of the mites and soothes the uncomfortable itching they cause.
how_it_works: Crotamiton works by killing the tiny mites that cause scabies, though exactly how it does this is not fully understood. It is applied directly to the skin, where it gets into the areas where the mites are living. It also has a calming effect on the skin that helps reduce that maddening itch.
common_side_effects: Some people may notice mild skin irritation, redness, warmth, or a rash where the cream is applied. Occasionally it can cause a slight burning or tingling sensation on the skin. These effects are usually mild and go away on their own.
warnings: Do not use this medication near your eyes, mouth, or on broken or inflamed skin unless your doctor tells you to. Keep it away from children's reach and do not let children apply it themselves. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before using this product. If you develop a severe skin reaction or the rash gets worse, stop using it and contact your doctor right away.
typical_dosing: For scabies, you typically apply the cream or lotion to your entire body from the chin down after a bath or shower, and leave it on for 24 hours. Then you apply a second coat without washing the first one off. After another 48 hours, you take a cleansing bath to wash it all off. Your doctor may recommend repeating this process. Always follow your doctor or pharmacist's specific instructions.
